line: Actor check: funders and field-builders
method: desk: RFPs, strategy pages, benchmarks
question: What do 20 funders and field-builders need before allocating to Vietnam, and does Part III tell them?
what_changed: Funder advice; public-meal decision map; corporate commitments; Asian institutional precedents
key_finding: No major funder names Vietnam; market-shaping funders count decisions, not attitudes; Nova Vista excludes diet change and whole-food plant-based work
notes: 30 questions: 0 answered, 19 partly, 10 not, 1 out of scope

line: Actor check: investors and startups
method: desk: investor sites, reports, company pages
question: What do 20 investors and startups need, and does Part III tell them?
what_changed: T1 economics; firm base rates; competitors; stale seafood advice
key_finding: Investors fund offtake and unit economics; regional startups pivoted to B2B and private label
notes: 25 questions: 1 answered, 19 partly, 3 not, 2 out of scope

line: Actor check: incumbents and first buyers
method: desk: annual reports, AGM documents, rules, tenders
question: What do 20 Vietnamese makers, retailers and caterers need, and does Part III tell them?
what_changed: School rules; private label; integrators as competitors; hospital and army data
key_finding: No incumbent states a plant-based target; Decision 3958 reserves plant-protein school days; Co.op private label

line: Actor check: policy, research and international bodies
method: desk: laws, decisions, programme documents
question: What do 20 policy, research and international actors need, and does Part III tell them?
what_changed: School and shift-meal rules; Food Safety Law timing; excise; nutrition quality
key_finding: Food Safety Law vote moved to May 2027; school guidance has no animal share; no plan targets meat intake
next_step_needs: Rule tracking; UNICEF and NIN calls
notes: 33 questions: 0 answered, 17 partly, 15 not, 1 out of scope

line: Public meals: rulebook, menu authority and menu audit
method: desk: primary rules; 48 coded school-weeks
question: Who decides the protein on public plates, and what fills the plant-protein slot?
yield_class: changed a conclusion; added a constraint
what_changed: School verdict (ch15); route R4 logic; DMV-05 and DMV-17; TPP-04
key_finding: Plant protein on 15.1% of school days; 9 of 48 weeks meet the rule; tofu beside meat; menu software prints a 48% animal-protein floor
next_step_needs: Software default and food list; MOET circular; caterer cost sheets; plate-waste trial

line: Fiscal and tariff rules
method: desk: laws, tariff schedules, labels
question: Do tariffs protect domestic protein makers, and does the sugary-drink excise reach plant milks?
what_changed: Tariff shelter (ch16, T1, TPP-01); plant-milk design (TPP-05, T10); new move DMV-20
key_finding: 0% duty on Chinese, ASEAN and Korean protein ingredients; 8% to 10% excise from 2027 may hit sweetened plant milks, dairy exempt
next_step_needs: Written MOF ruling; VAT invoices; Form E use

line: Funder units and funder fit
method: desk: model outputs, conversion factors, funder documents
question: What do the demand routes achieve in animals, CO2e and meals, and who would pay for each move?
yield_class: changed a conclusion; added a constraint
what_changed: Funder advice (ch18.6, ch25.4, brief-international); new funder-units table
key_finding: About 2.4 to 2.7 million animals and 0.14 Mt CO2e a year by 2035 on the benchmark path; import substitution delivers none; 4 of 19 moves have a fitting funder

line: Commitments, private label and competitors
method: desk: company policies, retailer and HoReCa sites
question: Do corporate commitments pull volume, can private label carry a protein upgrade, and who already competes in B2B channels?
yield_class: added a route; added constraints; clean negative on commitments
what_changed: Private label route (ch15.6, TPP-02); TPP-04 price benchmark; LE-09; buyer map
key_finding: Only Accor binds Vietnamese units; Co.op Select chay made by GN Foods; CP Meat Zero listed but not orderable; dry soy-gluten pieces already feed kitchens

line: Unit economics of domestic textured protein (T1) and non-entry
method: desk: equipment listings, trade data, cost build-up
question: Can a domestic textured-soy line pay, and why has nobody built one?
yield_class: changed a conclusion; added a constraint
what_changed: T1 thesis (not venture); kill test; TPP-01 price; lines supported by 2035
key_finding: Chinese lines listed at USD 11,000 to 100,000; flour price decides the margin; about one line by 2035, not three to four
next_step_needs: Delivered flour quotes; conditional orders; customs declarations

line: Base rates: firms, diet surveillance and trade seasons
method: desk: firm records, Diet Quality Questionnaire, monthly trade data
question: What do revealed base rates say about firm routes, chay days and import seasonality?
what_changed: Startup advice reworded; chay-day ceiling; 3504 feed reading; seasonal swing
key_finding: Channel did not predict survival; 7.9% flesh-free adult days; 2106.10 rises 33% before Vu Lan; 3504 behaves like feed
next_step_needs: Lunar-date tabulation of the diet survey; survey items for gio and cha

line: Label, claim and product-standard rules
method: desk: laws, decrees, national standards
question: Do Vietnamese rules already settle Part III's label moves and product claims?
what_changed: DMV-13 to DMV-16; TPP-02 and TPP-03 labels; GMO collision (ch14)
key_finding: High-protein claim at 10 g per 100 g; no minimum meat content; meat share already declared when named; vegetarian allows egg and milk; GMO label only above 5%
next_step_needs: Agency ruling on detectability; chay label compliance audit

line: Feed buyers as actors (T2 demand check)
method: desk: company reports, ASC register, trade data
question: Do feed mills and standards pull microbial feed protein?
what_changed: T2 evidence and kill test; ch17.5 standards reading; new TPP-11 for feed
key_finding: Vietnam imports about 9,200 t of inactive yeast for food and feed, 95% at about USD 1.1 per kg; ASC, BAP and GLOBALG.A.P. neither require nor reward microbial protein

line: Export buyers as actors
method: desk: retailer reports, supplier lists, mirror trade data
question: Do foreign buyers' targets and sourcing pull plant-based products from Vietnam?
yield_class: added a constraint; added a route; clean negatives
what_changed: Export base (stuffed pasta); TPP-08 buyers and requirements; Japan and Korea route downgraded
key_finding: Retailer protein targets are flat and met in Europe; wrapped foods (USD 128 million) are the real base; textured protein exports negligible
next_step_needs: Exporter-level customs data; importer quote test

line: Nutrition route: protein quality and micronutrients
method: desk: literature, rules, cost tables
question: What must a plant or blended protein meet for children and public meals?
yield_class: changed a conclusion; added a constraint (candidate later withdrawn)
what_changed: ch11.2 and ch11.8 framing; TPP-04 school variant; DIAAS table
key_finding: Protein is not the school-age gap; blends keep DIAAS high; no trial of textured soy in children
next_step_needs: School trial; phytate and zinc lab tests
notes: Its proposed zinc-fortified dish profile was withdrawn after W9-L2

line: E-commerce as revealed demand (desk tools)
method: desk fetch of marketplaces and reports
question: What do marketplace sales counters show?
what_changed: E-commerce as an incumbents' channel (ch15.1)
key_finding: Shopee, Lazada, Tiki and TikTok Shop unreadable with desk tools; kitchen counters agree with Part III

line: Hybrid extender economics over the pork cycle
method: desk: cost model, formulations, sensory literature
question: When do blends pay a processor?
yield_class: changed a conclusion; added a constraint
what_changed: TPP-03 price and replacement caps; T9 kill test; ch14.4
key_finding: Soy extension pays at every hog price since 2019; soy, not lean, is the benchmark; cap 10 to 20% in fine emulsions

line: Fillers, fakes and trust
method: browser and desk: press record 2015 to 2026
question: How do Vietnamese publics react to fillers, blends and fake chay?
what_changed: TPP-03 naming (avoid độn); DMV-07 test order; TPP-02 trust
key_finding: Hidden filler reads as cheating; declared soy draws no penalty; no confirmed case of meat in chay

line: Plates outside the big cities and in factory canteens
method: browser and desk: 22 upland school-weeks, 172 canteen dishes
question: What is on upland school and canteen plates?
yield_class: corrected a wave 8 proposal; added a route
what_changed: Upland framing (ch11.2); wave 8's proposed zinc-fortified dish withdrawn; canteen species mix; funder-unit ranges
key_finding: 240 of 242 upland main meals had meat, fish or egg; kitchens stretch pork with tofu; canteen dishes pork 33%, fish 26%, chicken 13%
next_step_needs: Served against planned meals; breakfast nutrition

line: Marketplace counters through the browser
method: browser: 96 SKUs on Lazada and Tiki
question: Do consumer marketplaces change the consumer picture?
yield_class: minor route; clean negative on two platforms
what_changed: Plant-milk and dry-piece evidence strengthened; no conclusion changed
key_finding: Best plant milk sells 60 to 79% of the best dairy SKU's litres; high-protein nut milk a niche; dry soy-gluten pieces sell by the tonne online

line: Rules of origin and export recipes
method: browser and desk: EVFTA, UKVFTA, CPTPP, RCEP texts
question: Does export origin give domestic textured soy a customer?
what_changed: ch17.3 origin paragraph; TPP-08 recipe advice; T1 evidence note
key_finding: Dumplings are indifferent to the origin of textured soy; the binding item is imported flour or starch in EU wrappers
